In other words, while free will is technically impossible, the perception of free will has the same implications. When we act as though we have free will, we are much more likely to demonstrate control in our lives[2]. We know this works with crime and punishment; we don't tell would-be criminals that they cannot help their behavior. More related: we don't tell that to meth addicts, because it negatively impacts treatment outcome.

tl;dr: There will always be tasty food, scantly clad women, and meth. We MUST tell society to exercise self-control, and to not go all Bill Cosby/Jared/Rockstar, because that telling is a stimulus just like the deliciousness of deep-fried-donuts. Accountability over acceptance.
